harborpass/support-replay-release-1-0-ru: HarborPass support_replay (case IOS-1842, issue trial-gl1) is pinned to the approved customer-facing release 1.0 notice rules: send_on = renewal_on minus 21 calendar days; credit only when autopay is true AND completed_years >= 2; credit = floor(plan_cents / 10) capped at 2400 cents, else 0; amount_due_cents = plan_cents - credit_cents; customer_id copied unchanged. Implemented in main.py release_1_0_notice(), which notice() currently delegates to. Later issues may change the customer-facing notice command, but release_1_0_notice() must stay fixed so support replays keep returning release 1.0 values.
